description: This file defines several classes related to the ViewModel of a graphing calculator application, including EquationViewModel, GridDisplayItems, and KeyGraphFeaturesItem. It declares properties, methods, and references to external classes used for data binding and UI updates in a Windows app.

classes.name: GridDisplayItems
classes.description: Represents display items for grid elements, with observable properties for expression and direction.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesItem
classes.description: Represents a key feature item in the graph, with observable properties for title, display items, grid items, and text flag.

classes.name: EquationViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for a graph equation, including properties for expression, color, line enablement, and key graph features.

methods.name: EquationViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the equation view model with a graph equation, label index, color, and color index.

methods.name: PopulateKeyGraphFeatures
methods.description: Populates key graph features based on provided info.

methods.name: EquationErrorText
methods.description: Returns an error message string based on error type and code.

methods.name: AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with a title, expression, and error string.

methods.name: AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with a title, a vector of expressions, and an error string.

methods.name: AddParityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds parity-related key graph features based on info.

methods.name: AddPeriodicityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds periodicity-related key graph features based on info.

methods.name: AddMonotoncityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds monotonicity-related key graph features based on info.

methods.name: AddTooComplexKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature indicating the function is too complex.
